explanation: I searched Mathlib for PerfectionMap, coeffFrobeniusRangesEquiv, iterateFrobenius ranges and iInf. The only file that mentions PerfectionMap is Mathlib/RingTheory/Perfection.lean. It has PerfectionMap.of, PerfectionMap.id and the comp and map lemmas. None of these says that the subtype map from the intersection of the Frobenius iterate ranges of a reduced characteristic-p ring is a perfection map.
